timing: Written before calculation of any v2 allocation outcomes. v1 allocation is preserved. No task outcomes exist. Opaque metadata only; no Curated partner IDs or prompt text delivered to optimization. Data preparation only.
population: Complete original official WildChat1.1,1000 tasks, count10, original typed IDs and text unchanged.
family_rule: Union complete original WildChat families transitively for every opaque WildChat-only cross-source component. Every resulting family is indivisible. Verify exact duplicate closure. Preserve all1000 original IDs/text/types/per-task uncertainty flags; family uncertainty is inherited or conservative component uncertainty. No Curated partner IDs leave custody.
family_stratum: Most frequent predeclared broad task-type code within family; ties use ascending code. Preserve individual task types separately.
base_allocation: Per family stratum with at least3families, reuse freeze_splits(seed=7) on whole families; it assigns approximately60/20/20 by family count. Strata with fewer3families remain wholly validation and are disclosed.
final_quotas: Over exposure-eligible base-final family pools, allocate26 proportional to prompt counts per family stratum: floor then remaining units in descending fractional remainder, ascending code for ties. No eligible family is split.
final_selection: Per stratum scan base-final families ordered by SHA256(canonicalJSON([7,sorted_member_IDs])) then members. Subset-sum DP begins0=empty; update prior totals in descending order, keep first-discovered subset for each total, ignore totals above quota. Require exact quota; fail rather than split a family, change seed, silently shrink or borrow quotas. Selected whole families become final; unselected base-final families become validation. Base development/validation remain.
development_selection: Allocate3 quotas proportional to base-development prompt counts by same largest-remainder rule. Per stratum choose that many distinct families ordered by SHA256(canonicalJSON([7,"development-panel",sorted_member_IDs])) then members; choose one original ID per selected family ordered by SHA256(canonicalJSON([7,"development-task",id])) then ID. Refuse if any stratum lacks required distinct families.
canonical_JSON: Existing compact sorted-key ensure_ascii=True JSON, finite values; string IDs retain type.
validation: Reuse complete-source TaskSet, policy_study._split and splits.validate_splits. Require all1000once, allassignedfinal26assessedlater, complete coarsened family/exact-duplicate separation, dev3distinct families, original task hashes and no blocked closure member in final. Check cross-source components each occupy one phase.
failure: Preparation stops with explicit stage/reason if full-map or allocation checks fail. No resampling/reranking/semantic manual selection after seeing content or outcomes.
claim_limits: One source, finite proposed panel;3devtasks cannot represent every task type. Group/type classification is model review, not human truth or independent-family evidence. No base-model training-invisibility guarantee.
exposure_exclusion: Close the blocked WildChat IDs over coarsened whole families. Exclude the complete closure from base-final candidate pools BEFORE proportional final quotas and subset DP. Blocked families remain assigned wholly to development or validation, with unselected base-final families moved wholly to validation. This is a prospective exposure safeguard, not score/hardness selection.
